jobs.title: Housing Resource Center (HRC) Program Manager
jobs.description:
**ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW**

Covenant House California (CHC) is a nonprofit organization that provides sanctuary and support for youth overcoming homelessness, ages 18-24. CHC believes that no young person deserves to be homeless; that every young person in California deserves housing, food, clothing, education, and most importantly, to be loved. CHC provides a full continuum of services to meet the physical, emotional, educational, vocational, and spiritual well-being of young people.

CHC’s doors are open to youth and staff regardless of their race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We believe that youth and team members deserve to be in an environment that is inclusive and affirming; where everyone is treated with dignity and respect and valued and appreciated for who they are. Maintaining a diverse community of youth and staff is key to our ability to achieve our mission most effectively. We are also committed to being a leader in advancing anti-racism, and to promoting opportunities for the free expression of the lived experiences of our youth and staff.

We are looking for people who, like us, believe that every young person deserves a place to belong. We think it takes all kinds of people to create diverse solutions to end youth homelessness, and we are on a committed journey to build an inclusive and equitable work culture that brings out the best in everyone. CHC’s Housing Resource Centers in Oakland and Hayward provide housing-focused services to transition-age youth experiencing or at risk of homelessness throughout Alameda County.

Covenant House California offers an excellent benefits package, including medical, vision, dental, an EAP program, a 403b retirement account, and a generous vacation package.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Housing Resource Center Program Manager (HRC Manager) manages the day-to-day delivery of CHC’s Transition Age Youth Housing Resource Center (HRC) program in Alameda County. Our bricks and mortar locations are in Oakland and Hayward, but the reach of this role is County wide. Reporting to the Oakland Programs Director, this position supervises HRC staff and coordinates housing prevention, Housing Problem Solving, Coordinated Entry access and assessment, targeted outreach, community referrals, housing education, employment resources, and healthcare linkages. The HRC Manager ensures services are youth-centered, strengths-based, trauma-informed, equitable, and consistent with CHC’s mission, policies, and Alameda County Health Housing and Homelessness Services requirements.

The HRC Manager provides leadership across both HRC locations and as needed throughout the county, supports staff development and retention, monitors service quality and outcomes, and works with the Data Coordinator/CES Matcher and Finance team to maintain accurate records, timely reports, and appropriate use of program funds. This position provides direct service and crisis support as needed while maintaining primary responsibility for program management and supervision.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Managerial / Supervisory Duties**

* Provide direct supervision, coaching, and performance management to assigned Coordinated Entry Outreach Service Coordinators/Case Managers and work collaboratively to support the Data Coordinator/CES Matcher and the employment specialist that support the HRC program.
* Partner with the Program Director and Human Resources to recruit, interview, hire, onboard, and evaluate staff; address performance concerns and promote a supportive, trauma-informed team environment.
* Conduct regular individual supervision and team meetings, lead case consultation, and support staff safety, professional development, and retention.
* Coordinate staffing, schedules, time off, and timely timesheet review to maintain coverage at both HRC locations during posted drop-in hours, evening and weekend services, appointments, and field-based outreach.
* Monitor caseload distribution and maintain the contract’s 1:50 staffing ratio; identify workload and coverage concerns and recommend adjustments to the Project Director.
* Ensure staff complete required HMIS privacy/security, Coordinated Entry, and Housing Problem Solving training within 30 days; naloxone training within 30 days; other required core training within 60 days; and at least 16 hours of ongoing training annually.

**Program Management and Housing Services**

* Oversee coordinated delivery of all eight HRC service categories and ensure services are accessible to eligible transition-age youth from throughout Alameda County, including youth unable to visit an HRC in person.
* Implement program ramp-up, hiring, and service delivery plans with the Program Director; develop and maintain procedures for referrals, participant and staff safety, and complaints and grievances.
* Ensure Housing Problem Solving conversations are offered before other Coordinated Entry interventions and continue alongside Coordinated Entry activities to identify safe housing resolutions, including housing search, reunification, mediation, relocation, and eligible flexible assistance.
* Oversee eligibility screening, Housing Support Plans, Crisis and Housing Needs Assessments, documentation collection, queue management, and timely follow-through on interim and permanent housing matches in accordance with County protocols.
* Ensure eligible clients receive housing assessments within 45 days of initial engagement; maintain at least monthly participant contact and Current Living Situation updates, and oversee reassessments and updates when circumstances change.
* Coordinate homelessness prevention services, including screening, housing stabilization plans completed before financial assistance, landlord communication, case management, and referrals. Support implementation of the County’s standardized prevention assessment and coordination with the Prevention HUB.
* Coordinate scheduled weekly field-based outreach throughout

jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives! LifeSTEPS is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services.**

We are seeking a highly motivated **Director of Social Services & Program Coordinator (On-Call)** who will:

* Empower low-income individuals and families to flourish by providing education and resources.
* Ensure our residents, specifically older adults to have an opportunity to thrive in place through housing and services.
* Encourage individuals and families through stable housing and supportive evidence-based services to build resilient communities.
* Maximize the strengths of individuals by providing client assistance, case management, service coordination and conducting community outreach.

**Additional duties will include:**

* Empowering children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing After School education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go to After School to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Job Specifics:**

* **Title:** Director of Social Services/Program Coordinator (On-Call)
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, 0-39 hours per week
* **Job location:** Fremont CA
* **Pay range:** $21.00-$28.35

**More about us:**

The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **“Skills Training and Educational Programs”** and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by **LifeSTEPS** will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology or any related field.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing social services to multi-families, senior and children.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree
* A background or experience working for a non-profit would be a big plus!
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support people so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? **Apply today!!!**

Involves designing, conducting, promoting, evaluating and supporting health professions education programs in compliance with organizational objectives and nationally accepted accreditation standards and requirements. Supports learners (including but not limited to faculty, residents, clinical fellows, graduate or undergraduate learners, practicing or licensed professionals) in areas such as curriculum, teaching and learning activities, scheduling, core competencies, assessment and evaluations. Coordinates all activities associated with ongoing administration of health professions education programs.

Experienced professional who knows how to apply theory and put it into practice with in-depth understanding of the professional field; independently performs the full range of responsibilities within the function; possesses broad job knowledge; analyzes problems / issues of diverse scope and determines solutions.

This includes financial management, reporting an oversight for the Biomedical Sciences (BMS) Graduate Program, the Developmental Stem Cell Biology (DSCB) Graduate Program, the Neuroscience Graduate Program, the Medical Scientist Training Program (MSTP), the PROPEL Post-Baccalaureate Program and the CIRM Training Program. jobs.description:
### **The Position**

**Who We Are**

Strategic Event Services brings together strategy, operational excellence, technology, and cross-functional expertise to deliver high-quality experiences across congresses, speaker programs, and advisory boards.

Our team works closely with Field, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, Legal, technology teams, speakers, and vendors. The Event Operations Manager reports to the Head of Strategic Event Services The role provides essential operational, compliance, financial, and administrative support, enabling smooth, compliant execution across a high volume of programs each year.

We are looking for an Event Operations Manager who can provide end-to-end operational excellence while helping Strategic Event Services strengthen and continuously improve how speaker programs are delivered.

**The Opportunity**

The Event Operations Manager, Speaker Programs is the internal operational owner for assigned speaker bureaus and programs, from bureau setup through program closeout. You will support HCP programs (in-person, virtual), Patient programs, and HCP and Patient product theaters, most organized into brand bureaus that run on a calendar-year cycle.

Our speaker program vendor manages day-to-day logistics and execution. You will direct that vendor, keep every program inside the compliance guardrails, and own the approval, financial, and documentation work that stays in-house.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Oversee Vendor Execution:** Direct the day-to-day work of our speaker program vendor across logistics, registration, attendee management, and speaker coordination. Set clear expectations, monitor performance against SLAs and KPIs, and resolve or escalate gaps.
* **Manage Bureau and Program Operations:** Coordinate annual bureau setup and close, program intake, timelines, and readiness. Adapt requirements to each program type, including Patient program needs such as patient speaker training, privacy, and adverse event reporting.
* **Operationalize Compliance:** Partner with Compliance and Legal to confirm speaker contracting, fair market value, and training are complete before programs proceed, and that attendee, venue, meal, and state-specific rules are met.
* **Manage Materials and Approvals:** Route speaker decks, invitations, and program materials through Commercial and Medical review. Track re-approvals and expirations so only current approved materials are in use.
* **Manage Financial Operations:** Support budgets, statements of work, purchase orders, invoices, accruals, and reconciliation. Validate speaker honoraria and HCP spend for Open Payments (Sunshine Act) and state transparency reporting.
* **Coordinate Across Functions:** Partner with the Marketing, Field, Medical, Compliance, and Finance, to resolve dependencies and provide visibility into progress and risks. Serve as an operational resource for field teams, and bring platform and data needs to the product team.
* **Report and Improve:** Work with our vendor to maintain trackers and standard reports on program activity, speaker utilization, exceptions, and vendor performance. Work with the product team to simplify and automate high-volume work and strengthen SOPs.

**Who You Are**

* You have a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* You have at least 4 years of experience in event operations, speaker program operations, project management, commercial operations, or a related field.
* Experience managing vendors that deliver high-volume programs or events, including tracking deliverables and resolving issues through appropriate escalation.
* Working knowledge of the rules governing interactions with healthcare professionals, such as the PhRMA Code, Anti-Kickback Statute, OIG guidance on speaker programs, and Open Payments (Sunshine Act) reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage many concurrent programs with strong organization and attention to detail.
* Experience supporting structured Commercial, Medical, regulatory, or other content-review and approval processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, including intermediate Excel, and the ability to learn program-management, content-management, and workflow platforms.
* Willingness to travel occasionally based on program needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting speaker programs or HCP engagement in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry.
* Experience supporting patient-facing programs, patient speakers, or patient advocacy engagement.
* Experience managing program exceptions, compliance documentation, or supporting audits and monitoring.
* Experience with vendor speaker portals, Veeva, Cvent, Jira, or comparable tools.
* Experience managing purchase orders, invoices, program budgets, spend reconciliation, and transparency reporting data.

This role requires an onsite presence at our South San Francisco, Genentech Campus.

Relocation benefits are **NOT** offered on this posting

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of South San Francisco, CA is $100,700/yr to $186,900/yr. **Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law**. jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
### **About EarnIn**

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

As a Senior Operations and Strategy Manager, you'll help bring our mission to life. You'll shape business strategy and success from the ground up, covering customer insights, go-to-market, customer adoption, product, and operations. EarnIn is making AI-native work a core capability. It's how we design, build, and ship, not an initiative. In this role, you'll apply that to how the business runs.

You'll operate like an early general manager: understanding business economics, defining strategy, and breaking big goals into work that gets done. As EarnIn adds business units, you may be placed where the need is greatest. You'll influence and develop the strategies for how EarnIn becomes a market leader. That includes defining new bets, incubating 0-1 experiments, scoping partnership opportunities, and executing on initiatives that drive growth and adoption. You'll be both a strategist and a builder, and you'll employ everything in your toolkit to architect strategy, discover new insights, and drive execution. Agents and AI workflows you help put in place will run in production, so they need to be fast, safe, and durable. The people who depend on EarnIn to access their pay when it matters most are the reason this work matters.

The Mountain View base salary range for this full-time position is $153,000-$187,000, plus equity and benefits. We determine salary ranges by role, level, and location. This is a hybrid position in Mountain View that requires in-office work 2 days a week.

**What You'll Do**

* Partner with the GMs to define the vision, then own and scale this opportunity with product, sales, operations, business development, finance, and other teams.
* Develop the roadmap and key proof points for B2B initiatives, and work with a small cross-functional team to bring the vision to life.
* Experiment quickly to drive go-to-market and customer adoption, then turn what you learn into scalable playbooks we use going forward.
* Identify where manual work in B2B go-to-market, adoption, and account operations can be replaced with agentic workflows, and partner with engineering to build them.
* Take AI pilots from experiment to production by turning what works into playbooks, templates, and reference implementations other teams can reuse.
* Take pilots that work and make them sustainable, so the next team can run them without starting over.
* Work with business development, sales, and account management on pitch decks and sales content that create new business opportunities.
* Create innovative solutions that drive growth and operational excellence, and implement product testing and roll-outs on the ground. Look at each step of how the B2B business operates and ask: why isn't an agent doing this?
* Establish and monitor performance metrics, and make results visible and trustworthy.
* Provide regular updates and reports to senior leadership, including the executive team, and build consensus to get new work done.

**What We're Looking For:**

* Bachelor's degree required. MBA or Master's degree is a plus.
* 4+ years of experience in Strategy and Operations, Consulting, Customer Success, Sales, Business Development, and/or Partnerships. Experience in startups, lean business units, or product incubation teams, where you owned work end to end with limited support, is advantageous.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools or agentic workflows to automate or improve business operations, such as GTM, sales, or customer success work
* A curious, sharp, first-principles thinker who is both a strategist and a builder, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by solving hard problems
* Experience leading cross-functional projects and hitting goals, including influencing and building alignment up to the executive level
* Comfort speaking directly with customers and partners, working with product and engineering, and managing revenue and costs
* Experience taking a pilot or experiment to a repeatable process other teams actually use
* Very strong verbal and written communication, and equal comfort interfacing internally and externally
* Strong data retrieval, analytics, and presentation skills, and comfort using data to drive decisions
* Enthusiasm for test and learn, no fear of failure, and demonstrated success in the face of roadblocks and limited resources
* A high degree of ownership, with curiosity across finance, marketing, and operations rather than staying in one lane

**You'll Stand Out If You Have:**

* SQL experience
* 0-1 experience in fintech products
* Experience in fintech or regulated, security-sensitive environments
* Experience with AI governance in a regulated environment

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Description:

**Primary Objective**

The Business Operations Manager leads the internal operations of a distribution business that supplies equipment and materials to contractors and public agencies in California for Traffic Signals, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), and underground utility projects. The role has authority over billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and office administration, and manages the supervisors and staff who perform that work. The Operations Manager serves as the primary liaison between the business unit and the corporate finance department, and is the local resource that employees, managers, and leadership turn to for operational questions and decisions.

This is not an accounting position. General ledger accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting are performed by the corporate finance department. The Operations Manager applies a strong working knowledge of accounting principles, including debits and credits, journal entries, inventory, fixed assets, and supporting documentation, to make sound operational decisions, ensure local transactions are accurate and complete, and support corporate finance.

JAM Services offers a Full Benefits plan including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and LTD insurance. We also provide a 401(K) plan with a 6% Safe Harbor match, PTO and 10 Holidays.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

The Business Operations Manager spends the majority of their time managing the business unit’s internal operations and the employees who carry them out. The role exercises discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the business unit, including staffing, credit and collection decisions, process design, and operating policies, within the overall direction of business unit leadership and corporate finance.

**Leadership and Team Management**

* Manages the AR / Collections, Billing, and office administration functions, directly supervising the AR / Collections Supervisor, the Billing Supervisor, and administrative staff.
* Hires, trains, and develops staff; sets performance expectations; conducts performance reviews; and makes decisions or recommendations on pay, promotion, discipline, and termination.
* Sets department priorities, staffing levels, and work schedules to meet business needs and deadlines.
* Builds a team culture of accuracy, accountability, and service to internal and external customers.

**Billing, Accounts Receivable, and Accounts Payable**

* Oversees billing, accounts receivable, collections, and accounts payable to ensure transactions are timely, accurate, and properly documented.
* Establishes and approves authority limits for credit, payment arrangements, adjustments, and write-offs, and makes final decisions on matters escalated by the supervisors, within corporate policy.
* Oversees the company’s lien and payment protection process to safeguard collections on private and public works projects.
* Reviews and approves vendor invoices, expense coding, and payment requests in accordance with corporate approval policies.
* Monitors cash flow drivers, including DSO, past-due balances, shipped-not-billed, and vendor payment timing, and takes action to address issues.

**Corporate Finance Liaison and Financial Support**

* Serves as the primary point of contact between the business unit and the corporate finance department.
* Provides corporate finance with accurate, complete documentation for journal entries, accruals, inventory, fixed assets, and month-end close.
* Researches and resolves account discrepancies, reconciling items, and audit requests in partnership with corporate finance.
* Translates financial information and corporate policies into practical guidance for local managers and staff.
* Supports budgeting and forecasting by providing operational data and insight to business unit leadership and corporate finance.

**Inventory, Assets, and Documentation**

* Oversees inventory transaction accuracy, cycle counts, and physical inventory processes in coordination with warehouse leadership.
* Maintains records and documentation for company assets, including equipment and vehicles, and supports fixed asset tracking.
* Ensures business records, contracts, and supporting documents are organized, retained, and accessible in accordance with company policy.

**ERP Systems and Technology**

* Serves as the business unit’s lead ERP user and decision-maker for local system setup, workflows, and reporting.
* Leads or supports ERP implementation activities, including process design, data migration, testing, training, and go-live support.
* Identifies opportunities to use system tools, automation, and AI to improve accuracy, efficiency, and reporting.
* Ensures staff are trained and use systems consistently and correctly.

**Office Administration**

* Oversees office administration, including facilities, office supplies, vendor services, and administrative processes.
* Partners with Human Resources on local administrative needs such as onboarding logistics, timekeeping oversight, and policy communication.
* Serves as the go-to resource for employees throughout the business unit on operational questions, policies, and procedures.

**Decision Support and Process Improvement**

* Provides business unit leadership with analysis and recommendations to support operational and financial decisions.
* Designs, documents, and implements standard procedures and internal controls across billing, AR, AP, and office operations.
* Develops and monitors key performance metrics and reports results to leadership.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Performance Measures**

* Days sales outstanding (DSO) and past-due balances.
* Shipped-not-billed balance and billing accuracy.
* Accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of documentation provided to corporate finance.
* Accounts payable processed accurately and on time.
* Inventory accuracy and audit results.
* Team performance, retention, and development.

jobs.description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

The Global Spares Planning Escalation Manager is responsible for leading end-to‑end management of high‑severity incidents, chronic issues, and escalated customer or stakeholder concerns across the Global Spares organization. This role ensures cross functional team formation, rapid containment, thorough root‑cause analysis, cross‑functional alignment, and implementation of long‑term corrective actions that improve operational stability and customer experience.

The position partners closely with Global Planning & Operations teams, Regional Spares, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Customer Operations, Product Groups and senior leadership to minimize business impact and prevent recurrence of systemic issues.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

**Escalation Ownership & Incident Response**

* Serve as single point accountability for critical business/customer critical escalations, ensuring timely, transparent communication and resolution.
* Lead cross‑functional response teams to drive coordinated actions for high‑severity operational issues.
* Assess escalation across technical, operational and commercial dimensions to balance priority across the team.
* Accurately document incidents, containment, root cause, and decisions.
* Executive communication and alignment.
* Cross-functional leadership without direct authority.
* Decision facilitation & tradeoff management.
* Monitor incident progress, remove barriers, and escalate risks as needed to ensure swift containment and recovery.

**Problem Management**

* Rapid Problem Framing (Signal>Noise): taking fragmented inputs and quickly framing the problem, blocking issue/decision, and business impact.
* Taking a systems approach throughout the semiconductor value chain allows issues and solutions to be assessed in terms of suppliers, factories, production, installation, customer process qualification, and customer FAB operations.
* Drive structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using industry‑standard methodologies (e.g., 8D, PS&DM, Five Whys, Fishbone).
* Develop, track, and validate corrective and preventative actions, ensuring long‑term fixes are implemented and sustained.
* Maintain a centralized repository of known issues, workarounds, best practices, and lessons learned.
* Partner with Planning, Operations, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, and leadership teams to ensure end‑to‑end process alignment.
* Facilitate post‑incident reviews, ensuring clear accountability and handoffs for remediation and continuous improvement activities.

**Communication & Reporting**

* Provide clear, concise, and executive‑ready updates during live escalations and throughout incident resolution cycles.
* Publish detailed incident reports, RCA summaries, and postmortem documentation to drive organizational learning.
* Develop metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to track incident trends, performance, and improvement progress.
* Present insights and recommendations to leadership, influencing decisions that enhance service reliability and operational maturity.

**Who we’re looking for**
-------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 7–10+ years of experience in technical support, operations, incident management, supply chain operations, or similar roles.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to rapidly understand complex systems and processes.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams and drive decision‑making in high‑pressure, time‑sensitive environments.
* Excellent communication skills, including executive‑level reporting, stakeholder management, and customer‑facing interactions.
* Strong project management capabilities with a continuous improvement mindset and experience implementing corrective actions.
* Ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across diverse operational and technical teams.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in a global supply chain, high‑tech manufacturing, or logistics environment.
* Familiarity with ERP, planning, or fulfillment systems (e.g., SAP, Kinaxis, SPM).
* Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, or similar process improvement methodologies.
* Experience with ITIL frameworks (Incident Management, Problem Management).
* Proven ability to develop scalable escalation processes or operational playbooks.

------------------

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

* Experience with data analysis, data analytics, quantitative analysis.

* Strong understanding of the creator ecosystem and support operations best practices.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Support Operations organization collaborates with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, Vendor Operations, Scaled Comms, Business Technology, Data Science and Legal, to identify and address user pain points and improve the overall support experience. Our team is tasked with developing innovative and user-centric support solutions that address the evolving needs of YouTube's user base. We drive the implementation of self-service tools and automated support workflows, and equip support agents with the knowledge, tools and skills to provide high quality service.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing end-to-end support solutions for our vast paid user base and content creator ecosystem. This role oversees the development and implementation of support experiences that enable creator growth, focusing on seamless account approvals, digital identity verification, and proactive policy education. You will proactively identify friction points in the monetization journey, eliminating systemic bottlenecks to provide exceptional service through both AI-driven and live agent interactions.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

jobs.title: Operations Manager- CA
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.

The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.

Essential Functions:

1. Management

Lead others and work effectively with store crews

Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew

Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner

Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement

2. Customer Service

Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints

Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**

Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.

Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill

Ability to work a full-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise

  
**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

 **Education**

High school diploma or equivalent required

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

40

**Time Type**

Full time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$24.50 - $38.50

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

**\*\*Monday through Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm\*\***

As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

M c M U L L E N

Senior Operations Manager

Maiden Lane Flagship, with presence at Sacramento Street · San Francisco

F u l l - t i m e · I n - p e r s o n

McMullen is a luxury multi-brand boutique built on a clear point of view: that

fashion is more powerful when it makes room for new voices. For nearly two

decades we've championed emerging designers alongside established names,

building a curated edit and a community of clients who trust us to find what they

didn't know they were looking for.

With our Maiden Lane flagship now open, we're building the operational backbone

that will carry McMullen through its next chapter. We're hiring a Senior

Operations Manager to lead that work.

The Role

The Senior Operations Manager owns operations across McMullen's two stores.

You're the person who makes sure the day-to-day runs smoothly, the systems scale,

and the operational foundation is strong enough to support how quickly the

business is growing.

You'll be based at the Maiden Lane flagship, with regular presence at Sacramento

Street. You'll manage our Logistics Lead at Sacramento Street, partner closely

with the Director of Retail on fleet-wide operations, and report to the CEO.

What You'll Own

Systems and team

* Day-to-day operations at the Maiden Lane flagship and Sacramento Street,

including receiving, fulfillment, and inventory

* The operational systems and playbooks that let the business scale: standards,

processes, and tools that work across stores

* Ensure store teams have clear processes, tools, and resources to successfully

execute their responsibilities

* Management of the Logistics Lead at Sacramento Street, including

development, coaching, and 1:1s

Inventory and execution

* Oversee inventory processes and ensure inventory is maintained accurately

across locations

* Support inventory counts, audits, transfers, receiving, and reconciliation

processes

* Identify recurring inventory issues and work with leadership to develop

solutions that prevent repeat errors

* Vendor operations: RAs, transfers, receiving accuracy, and coordination with

the buying team on incoming orders

Cross-functional partnership

* Cross-store logistics: transfers, inventory reconciliation, and operational

consistency across locations

* Partnership with the Director of Retail on floor operations, POS, and

operational KPIs

What We're Looking For

* 5+ years of operations leadership experience, ideally in luxury retail, DTC, or

specialty retail

* Proven track record building operational systems that scale across multiple

locations

* Strong people leadership: experience managing direct reports and developing

them well

* Deep fluency with retail operations: POS, inventory systems, receiving,

fulfillment

* Comfort with the mix of strategic thinking and hands-on execution that a small

luxury business requires

* A calm, structured operator who brings order to fast-moving environments

* Strong written communication and documentation instincts

* Comfort working closely with a founder who cares about how the details are

done

Why McMullen

Working at McMullen means being part of a brand that has spent years building

real conviction about what luxury retail can be. Our clientele is loyal, our designer

relationships run deep, and our team is small, smart, and serious about what we

do. This role is for someone who wants to build the operational backbone that

carries McMullen into its next chapter, and grow alongside it.

Compensation

Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience. Includes base

salary, performance bonus, and benefits. Details discussed in the interview

process.

Send a resume and a brief note about why this role interests you to

jobs@shopmcmullen.com.

Our unique, decentralized organizational structure fosters entrepreneurial leadership and drives excellent performance. We manage locally, enabling us to move at the speed of a small business, with the financial stability and global resources of an industry-leading, international company.
  
  
**Position:** Project Manager
  
WHO WE ARE
  
At NovaSensor, an Amphenol company, we are pioneers in high accuracy sensing solutions. As a global leader in MEMS (Microelectromechanical Systems) technology, we design and manufacture advanced pressure sensors that power critical applications across the medical, automotive, industrial, and consumer markets—whether it's enabling life-saving medical devices, enhancing vehicle safety and efficiency, or ensuring reliability in industrial systems.
  
We are part of Amphenol, a global leader in advanced interconnect systems, serving diverse markets including automotive, aerospace, industrial, and mobile devices. Amphenol Corporation, a member of the Fortune 500 (NYSE: APH), was established in 1932 and has pioneered innovation in electronics for nearly a century across virtually every end market.
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
In your role as Project Manager for Amphenol NovaSensor you will be responsible for planning and managing new product and customer development projects from conception to product launch and play an important role in the growth of our business.
  
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  

* Lead projects from business award through start of production, ensuring on-time, on-budget, and high-quality delivery.

WHAT YOU BRING ALONG
  

* Bachelor of Science in an Engineering discipline
* 5+ years of experience successfully delivering new product development projects on time, on budget and with high quality

* Experience delivering projects within APQP standards (desired)

WHERE YOU WILL WORK
  
On-site in Fremont, CA
  
  
WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM
  

* Competitive salary and benefits package and 401(k) with company match
* Health and wellness programs
* Professional onboarding and training opportunities
* Inclusive and collaborative work environment

Across our organization, we encourage trying new things, making informed bets, and taking personal ownership to see changes through.

-----------

We are actively recruiting experienced Construction Project Managers for established general contractors specializing in ground-up multifamily, podium construction, mixed-use developments, affordable housing, and market-rate apartments.

We are seeking Project Managers who can oversee projects from preconstruction and initial sitework through vertical construction, interiors, inspections, and final turnover. Ideal candidates have experience with Type III/Type V, wood-frame, concrete, and podium construction, along with a strong background in managing project budgets, schedules, subcontractors, contracts, and client relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage ground-up multifamily and mixed-use construction projects from preconstruction through final completion.
* Oversee all phases of construction, including sitework, foundations, podium, framing, MEP, interiors, and turnover.
* Develop and maintain project budgets, schedules, cost forecasts, and overall project plans.
* Lead subcontractor bidding, buyout, contract negotiations, and procurement activities.
* Manage project financials, including cost tracking, change orders, monthly billings, and budget updates.
* Coordinate closely with Superintendents to maintain construction schedules, trade sequencing, and project milestones.

* Monitor subcontractor performance, material procurement, and long-lead items to prevent project delays.
* Identify constructability challenges, scheduling conflicts, and potential cost impacts.
* Coordinate city inspections, third-party testing, and project requirements with field leadership.
* Ensure projects meet contract requirements, quality standards, and safety expectations.
* Manage punch lists, unit turnover, closeout documentation, and final project completion.
* Maintain strong client relationships throughout the construction process.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 5+ years of experience as a Project Manager with a general contractor preferred.
* Strong ground-up multifamily construction experience required.
* Experience managing projects from preconstruction through final completion.
* Knowledge of podium, Type III/Type V, wood-frame, and concrete construction.
* Experience managing project budgets, schedules, subcontractor buyout, contracts, and cost control.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement, scheduling, and subcontractor coordination.
* Experience managing RFIs, submittals, change orders, monthly billings, and project financials.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, civil, and MEP drawings.
* Strong communication, leadership, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with large multifamily projects of 100+ units preferred.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* Competitive base salary based on experience
* Performance-based bonus opportunities
* Car allowance or company vehicle
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid holidays and PTO
* Career advancement opportunities

jobs.title: GPR Project Manager - San Jose, CA
jobs.description:
Ground Penetrating Radar Systems is the nation's largest company specializing in the detection of underground utilities, video pipe inspection, and the scanning of concrete structures. GPRS has an extensive nationwide network of highly trained and experienced Project Managers in every major U.S. market. When clients hire GPRS, they have the peace of mind of knowing that they have the most reliable scanning technology on their job site and they'll receive the assistance of a Project Manager who can provide them with the most accurate data. For over two decades, GPRS has been the industry leader by providing outstanding service and cutting edge technology, Intelligently Visualizing The Built World by keeping projects on time, reducing safety risks, and putting our relationships with our clients before profit.  
  
**GPRS Purpose Statement:**  
Our purpose, as an organization, is to provide possibility for our Team Members and Customers by intelligently visualizing the built world.  
  
**GPRS Core Values:**

* Integrity
* Teamwork
* Mutual Respect
* Growth Mindedness
* Safety

Our GPRS Project Managers are more than technicians. It’s their commitment to being leaders in the industry and serving customers from beginning to end which sets them apart from the competition. When you join the team as a GPR Project Manager you will receive best in class training to become a ground penetrating radar expert solving our clients’ subsurface locating needs. Your primary focus will be private utility locating and concrete scanning to mitigate the risk of delayed projects and serious injury on site. You’ll experience a career where there is no typical day in the field, every job site is different, every area that needs imaging and scanning is different.

Project Managers receive a base salary + monthly bonus that will bring a total annual income between $65,000 - $75,000, after initial paid training is complete.

A successful candidate to join our team is someone who:

* thrives in new situations and looks forward to different work experiences
* loves being independent and excels at managing your time effectively
* brings excellence in customer service each day to increase our customer base and demonstrate our commitment to quality and safety
* professional, prepared, and proficient in every interaction (written and verbal)
* self-motivated to go above and beyond to enhance customer needs at every interaction
* maintains continuous curiosity about the latest industry trends and technology
* has a compass of strong values that drive your strong work ethic that include Integrity, Mutual Respect, Growth Mindedness, Teamwork and Safety

* Drive and ability to learn how to use GPR and other equipment to complete locating projects – we have the experts and a state-of-the-art facility to teach you, we need to know you want to learn new skills and have the drive for safety and excellence in everything you do
* Possess skills in Microsoft Office including Word and Excel
* Must be physically capable of carrying up to 60 pounds
* Work / walk on concrete and/or walk for long periods of time
* Are comfortable working on small to large construction sites
* Ability to work a flexible schedule – including nights/weekends as needed
* Able to pass a drug screen
* Valid driver’s license and a safe driving record
* Must live within or willing to move within 30 - 50 miles of posted city

**Why you will love working at GPRS?**

Each Project Manager receives a company vehicle, equipment, laptop, and cell phone.

We offer full medical, dental, and vision insurance with day-one coverage, 401k with company matching, Life, Short-Term, and Long-Term Disability at no cost to our employees, weekly pay, paid holidays, paid time off, Project Manager promotion tracks, leadership development training programs and additional benefits to support our strong commitment to the development of each team member.

GPRS is an Equal Opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the Role**
------------------

Anthropic's Executive Briefing program brings senior leaders from our most strategic customers together with our spokespeople, product leaders, and researchers. As a Program Manager, Executive Briefings, you will run the program at one of our briefing centers and help build the global operating model that ensures an exceptional and consistent experience across the globe.

You will be the main program lead for your location and own briefings end to end: qualification and intake, agenda design, speaker selection, and day-of execution. You will set the objectives and design for each agenda and develop it jointly with Sales. You will also be the local account teams' go-to partner on how to use a briefing to move their most important opportunities forward.

You will manage the global workstream and set the standard every center follows, so customers get the same quality of briefing wherever they meet us. This is a highly cross-functional role. You will work with regional GTM leadership and the Office of the CCO on account selection and program strategy, with Product Marketing on content, with Solutions on technical deep-dives and demos, with Anthropic's executive bench on sponsorship and participation, and with Workplace, Security, and Revenue Operations on the experience and systems behind every briefing. You will be comfortable running every part of a briefing yourself and maintaining tight alignment with internal stakeholders.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the Executive Briefing program at your location: the local calendar, capacity planning, the request and intake process from Sales, and operating SLAs, applied against global criteria and regional allocation
* Work with regional GTM leadership to decide which strategic accounts receive a briefing each quarter, hold the qualification bar, and proactively surface accounts that should be engaged
* Lead discovery with account teams before each briefing to understand the customer's objectives, business context, and stage of evaluation, and turn that into a tailored agenda
* Own agenda design and co-own agenda development with Sales for every briefing, including the narrative arc, discussion topics, speakers, and demos
* Build and manage the speaker bench for your location: identify, source, and match speakers to briefings, run prep, and manage capacity so no one is over-asked
* Own day-of orchestration and the customer experience standard at your center, in partnership with Workplace on logistics
* Contribute to the playbooks, tooling, and best practices that let the program scale consistently across centers while allowing for regional nuance
* Share intake and triage on a rotation across time zones so every request gets a decision within the defined SLA
* Maintain one source of truth for criteria, lead times, and process so account teams get one answer
* Own measurement and reporting for your center and contribute to global reporting on briefing volume, capacity and allocation, strategic-account coverage, and program-influenced pipeline and expansion
* Onboard and coach briefing team members and contractors across locations

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Experience running executive briefings, customer events, or a comparable program for senior external audiences
* Program management skills, including intake and prioritization, capacity planning, and managing multiple concurrent programs against SLAs
* Experience designing agendas and facilitating discussions with C-level or other senior customer audiences
* Experience building processes, playbooks, or tooling that help a program operate consistently
* Ability to track, report on, and communicate program metrics such as volume, coverage, and pipeline influence
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to partner credibly with field leadership, executives, and internal subject matter experts
* Work on site at your briefing center when briefings take place

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* 6+ years of experience building or scaling an executive briefing program, or a similar customer-facing program, at an enterprise technology company
* Experience in a high-volume briefing environment
* Experience with CRM and reporting tools such as Salesforce, and with connecting program activity to pipeline and expansion outcomes
* Experience identifying and surfacing speakers for the speaker bench and managing speaker capacity across product, research, and executive teams
* Experience working across time zones or across multiple sites to set one global standard
* Experience onboarding or coaching new team members or contractors
* Familiarity with AI products and how enterprises evaluate and adopt them
* Interest in Anthropic's mission to build AI that is safe and beneficial

jobs.title: Program Manager

**Company Details:**
====================

The Services Program Manager leads assigned programs to deliver contractual, financial, customer, operational, and technical outcomes on time, within budget, and to required quality standards. The role is responsible for program financial performance, stakeholder engagement, risk and issue management, and customer satisfaction, with strong emphasis on identifying and converting additional scope (“farming”) within the existing account, a primary measure of success in this role. The Services Program Manager works under limited supervision and direction, regularly exercising discretionary and substantial decision-making authority in a heavily matrixed organization, coordinating cross-functional and offshore teams with the expectation to move quickly, stay organized and remain effective under ambiguity. The role may also provide leadership and management of a service delivery team and is responsible for the performance and outputs of that team. Must be based in, or able to regularly work from, the San Francisco Bay Area.

**Job Details:**
================

**Essential Job Duties and** **Responsibilities:**

* Accountable for leading program execution to meet agreed schedule, cost, quality, and contractual commitments, including avoiding liquidated damages where applicable. Establish program goals, scope, milestones, deliverables, resource plans, risk mitigation strategies, and issue-resolution actions; monitor performance and drive corrective actions to ensure compliant and successful delivery.
* Own day-to-day program management for one or more systems under Operations & Maintenance (O&M), establishing goals, milestones, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies, and driving corrective actions to ensure service levels, schedule, cost, and quality commitments are met throughout the sustainment lifecycle.
* Ensure assigned programs are executed in compliance with contract requirements, Cubic policies, procedures, and department instructions.

* Serve as the primary customer-facing point of contact, building trusted relationships that support account retention, drive customer satisfaction, and surface opportunities to expand the scope of work.
* Proactively identify, shape, and pursue additional business within the existing account (“farming”), partnering with sales and account leadership to convert customer needs into new change orders or scope expansions; track and report growth pipeline and bookings as a key measure of success.
* Plan and manage resources to ensure program activities are appropriately staffed, fully aligned to schedule needs, completed on time, within budget, and consistent with customer expectations.
* Maintain program financial health by tracking budgets, invoicing, cost-to-complete, and cost/schedule performance for all work, and escalate variance early.
* Lead the full change order lifecycle — scoping, rough-order-of-magnitude and detailed estimates, proposal development, negotiation, execution, and closeout — in coordination with engineering, finance, and contracts.
* Demonstrate command of contract terms and conditions; identify potential entitlements, deviations, or recoverable impacts; and lead change documentation, claims, equitable adjustments, and recovery actions in coordination with leadership, contracts, and legal counsel.
* Review program and service performance metrics and trends to identify risks, opportunities, and process or system improvements, and drive actions that improve program outcomes.
* Manage requirements, risks, issues, schedule, communication, documentation, validation, verification, delivery, and close-out for integrated hardware and software programs, ensuring alignment to contract requirements, CDRLs, verification methods, and acceptance criteria.
* Comply with company values, policies, procedures, code of conduct, quality, security, safety, environmental, and HR requirements.
* Perform other duties assigned by the manager, as reasonably required.

**Minimum Job Requirements:**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, systems engineering, computer science, or a related technical/engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. jobs.description:
Full-time · Hourly · On-site in Milpitas, CA 95035 · Bilingual Mandarin/English required

**About us**

We're a next-gen cabinet manufacturer rethinking how design and production come together. Combining AI-powered design tools with precision local manufacturing, we deliver custom-quality cabinets at startup speed.

**The role**

You'll be the bridge between our sales and design team and the shop floor. Reporting to our GM Operations and working closely with our Production Lead, you'll keep sold jobs on track from handoff to delivery — checking in materials, running QC on finished work, and keeping inventory and purchasing records accurate. Just as important, you'll be the day-to-day link to our Mandarin-speaking production staff, making sure job details, changes, and quality issues are clearly understood on both sides. You'll also work with customers, contractors, and vendors, mostly in English. You won't be building product, but you'll know the shop well enough to spot when something's off.

**Sales operations**

* Receive each sold job from the sales and design team and check the production package is complete (dimensions, finishes, hardware) before it goes to the floor
* Be the go-to contact for the sales and design team, knowing order status, production timelines, and delivery or install scheduling
* Keep job records and customer notes current in our CRM and project tools
* Flag schedule changes or delays to customers and the sales team early
* Coordinate punch-list and warranty follow-up with production

**Receiving, QC & production support**

* **Receiving:** check in deliveries against POs, inspect sheet goods, hardware, and finishes for damage and spec, and log discrepancies with vendors
* **Quality control:** run QC checks on cabinet boxes, doors, and finishes against job specs before packing and shipping; document issues and pass them to the Production Lead
* **Inventory:** maintain stock levels and locations, run scheduled cycle counts, and keep the system of record (QuickBooks or similar) accurate
* **Purchasing support:** prepare POs for approval, request vendor quotes, track lead times and deliveries, and follow up with suppliers
* **Production communication:** relay job details and customer changes to the production team, track job milestones, and flag material shortages or delays to the GM Operations and Production Lead
* Follow shop safety rules when on the floor and help keep receiving and QC areas organized

**Required**

* Fluent spoken and written **Mandarin and English**
* Strong attention to detail, especially with measurements, specs, and paperwork; willing to learn to read shop drawings and cut lists
* Organized across many open jobs at once, with clear follow-through
* Comfortable with SaaS tools (Google Workspace, ClickUp, QuickBooks, or similar) and spreadsheets
* Comfortable spending part of the day on a shop floor; able to occasionally lift up to 50 lbs when checking in deliveries

**Preferred**

* 2+ years in an office, operations, customer service, or coordination role
* Experience in a manufacturing, warehouse, or production environment
* Mechanically inclined; familiarity with CNC or fabrication
* Receiving, QC/inspection, inventory-control, or purchasing experience; familiarity with ERP/MRP systems
* Customer service or project-coordination experience (HubSpot or similar CRM)
* Comfortability using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to draft communications, organize information, and speed up everyday work

**Why join us**

* Build the future of local manufacturing at a fast-moving startup
* Work alongside designers, engineers, and makers who love what they do
* See your impact on every job that ships
* Clear growth path toward Operations Lead or Production Manager

**Pay:** $28–$32 per hour, based on experience (hourly, overtime-eligible)

**Benefits:** 401(k); health, dental, vision, and life insurance; paid time off; professional development assistance

**Location:** In person, Milpitas, CA 95035 (commute required)

Zūm is revolutionizing mass mobility with its Connected Mobility Experience (*Zūm CMX*™) system that connects and coordinates people, vehicles, and operations in real time. In the $50 billion student mobility market – the largest segment of the mass mobility industry – *Zūm CMX* is transforming a daily source of anxiety and disruption into a reliable, transparent, and efficient mobility experience for students and families. Today, more than 6,500 schools rely on *Zūm CMX*. Recognized globally for its innovative approach and operational execution, Zūm has been named to Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50 and Changemakers, the World Economic Forum, and the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies lists. Zūm is backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, GIC, TPG, and Softbank.

We’re looking for a Corporate Paralegal & Legal Program Manager to support a lean, fast-moving Legal function and report directly to the General Counsel. This is a high-volume, fast-paced environment with a lean team. If you like owning your lane, juggling many workstreams, and making the legal function run better, keep reading.  
  
***This role is based at the Company’s headquarters in Redwood Shores, CA and requires you to be onsite 3x/week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).***

**Corporate Governance & Entity Management:** Maintain the corporate records for Zum and its subsidiaries: minute books, board and stockholder consents and resolutions, cap table support, and corporate level entity controls, signature and delegation policies, and other policy compliance activities. **Outside Counsel & Vendor Management:** Manage the outside counsel roster, engagement letters, and rate arrangements. Review invoices against budgets and billing guidelines, track spend by matter and function, and prepare regular legal spend reports for the GC and Finance. jobs.title: Supported Employment Program Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT RITTER CENTER:

For over 40 years, Ritter Center has been dedicated to preventing and resolving homelessness and improving the health, dignity, and well-being of people living in poverty in Marin.

When you join Ritter Center, you join a highly trained staff that combines national clinical best practices with a whole-person care approach to solving each person’s medical and mental health, housing, and food needs.

We are growing to meet the needs of our community. We are looking for staff who are ready for a career with a mission-driven organization, want to be valued, have diverse experience, and have compassion. If this sounds like you, we would love to have you join us!

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**CURRENT OPENING:**

**Supported Employment Program Manager**

**Full-time (40 Hours), Exempt**

**Annual Pay: $80,000-95,000**

**All positions at Ritter Center require a background check and Livescan fingerprinting.**

**Please visit our jobs page on our** **website** **for a complete list of our employee benefits.**  
  
Ritter Center is currently recruiting for a **Supported Employment Program Manager** to join our Senior Leadership Team. This full-time, exempt position reports to the CEO and is based in San Rafael, CA

**Position Description:**

The Supported Employment Program Manager provides oversight to Ritter Center’s Individual Placement and Support (IPS) program, a model of supported employment for people with serious mental illness. This role works closely with and expands our partnership with the County of Marin’s Behavioral Health and Recovery Services (BHRS) division.

The Program Manager will ensure high fidelity to the IPS evidence-based practice and positive client outcomes by providing training, supervision, and working side-by-side with Employment Specialists (field mentoring). They will monitor outcomes and implement quality improvement plans for individuals served while also acting as a liaison to other departments and agencies. This role supervises the Employment Specialists and Benefits Specialist and provides direct supported employment services initially and ongoing as needed.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities**

* Works in partnership with BHRS and the California IPS Center of Excellence to arrange for IPS Training and fidelity reviews. Assists with the development of fidelity action plans based on recommendations from the fidelity report.
* Hires, trains, and evaluates staff. Develops expectations for specialists regarding employer contacts, number of job starts each quarter, and employment rate (percentage of people employed on each caseload).
* Assigns each employment specialist to Marin County BHRS Full Service teams.
* Attends each BHRS treatment team meeting monthly, or more often as needed, to enhance integrated services.
* Conducts weekly group supervision following the principles of IPS supported employment.
* Oversees program documentation and ensures compliance with BHRS clinical documentation standards, SmartCare requirements, Medi-Cal billing requirements, and quality assurance expectations.
* Monitors contract performance measures, service utilization, employment outcomes, fidelity benchmarks, and quality improvement indicators to ensure compliance with County and State requirements
* Serves as primary lead for IPS fidelity reviews, corrective action plans, implementation monitoring, and coordination with the California IPS Center of Excellence.
* Ensures compliance with DHCS, Medi-Cal, HIPAA, BHRS, CalAIM, Behavioral Health Services Act (BHSA), and applicable federal, state, and county requirements.
* Prepares for and participates in county, state, federal, and fidelity audits, monitoring visits, corrective action processes, and reporting reviews.
* Provides individual supervision for employment specialists. Supervision includes some office-based sessions, as well working side-by-side with specialists.
* Collects client outcomes monthly. Shares outcomes for the program, as well as individual practitioners, with the supported employment team each quarter.
* Helps team members set goals, review individual outcomes, and develop written plans to refine skills and improve outcomes.
* Acts as a liaison to other department coordinators and administrators in the organization.
* Communicates regularly with mental health supervisors to ensure that services are integrated, to resolve issues, and to act as a proponent for employment.
* Works with the division of BHRS to coordinate services. Coordinates monthly meetings between team members to discuss how to help people served by both agencies.
* Leads or participates in steering committee meetings to help with IPS supported employment implementation and sustainability.
* Provides supported employment services when the team needs additional support.
* Verifies/approves bi-weekly staff timesheets.
* Other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in behavioral health, rehabilitation, counseling, social work, psychology, public health, or a related field. Equivalent years’ experience can be substituted for education requirement.
* Previous supported employment experience and/or community job placement services
* Previous experience in the behavioral health field
* Previous supervisory experience
* Must have a valid CA driver’s license and satisfactory driving record

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree and/or professional licensure (LCSW, LPCC, LMFT, Psychologist, CRC, or equivalent)
* Experience with IPS programs or other supported employment programs serving people with serious mental illness

jobs.title: US Immigration Program Manager
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a US Immigration Program Manager to serve as the organization's foremost subject-matter expert on immigration case filings and compliance operations across every market where we operate. This role is responsible for driving the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of immigration filings at scale, maintaining Meta's global compliance posture, and developing the frameworks, playbooks, and tooling that underpin our immigration program.This individual will partner closely with Recruiting, People Partners, Legal, external counsel, and business leaders to solve the most complex immigration challenges, ensure regulatory compliance, and continuously improve our case management operations. This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who combines deep immigration expertise with operational rigor, a compliance-first mindset, and the ability to influence across functions without direct authority.  
  
  

### **US Immigration Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Own the design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Meta's global immigration compliance framework, including right-to-work verification, government reporting, audit readiness, and regulatory change management across all operating jurisdictions
* Serve as Meta's principal subject-matter expert on employment-based visa filings (e.g., H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN, ICT, Global Mobility visas, permanent residence pathways), providing authoritative guidance on case strategy, filing requirements, and adjudication trends
* Personally manage and oversee a portfolio of complex, high-profile, and time-sensitive immigration filings, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with all applicable laws and regulations
* Develop and maintain standardized filing playbooks, templates, checklists, and quality-control protocols that enable consistent, high-quality case preparation at scale
* Monitor global regulatory developments across key markets (US, EMEA, APAC) and proactively translate new requirements into updated policies, processes, and operational guidance
* Drive technology and process innovation in case management workflows — identifying opportunities for automation, AI-assisted compliance checks, and system enhancements to reduce cycle times and improve accuracy
* Act as an escalation point for complex filing scenarios, RFEs (Requests for Evidence), denials, and novel immigration questions, providing expert analysis and recommended resolution paths
* Establish and enforce quality standards and SLAs for external immigration counsel and service providers, reviewing work product and driving accountability for filing accuracy and timeliness
* Partner cross-functionally with Legal, People Partners, Recruiting, and Finance to ensure immigration operations are aligned with workforce planning, business expansion, and talent strategy
* Develop compliance dashboards, reporting mechanisms, and audit processes that provide real-time visibility into filing volumes, cycle times, compliance health, and risk exposure
* Represent Meta's immigration compliance perspective in cross-functional forums and contribute to industry working groups and policy discussions as appropriate

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in global immigration with direct, hands-on responsibility for case filings, compliance program design, and work-authorization counseling
* Deep subject-matter expertise across employment-based visa categories, permanent residence pathways, and cross-border mobility in US, EMEA, and APAC jurisdictions
* Demonstrated experience designing and operating immigration compliance frameworks across multiple countries and regulatory environments
* Proven ability to manage high-volume, complex filing portfolios while maintaining exceptional accuracy and compliance standards
* Track record of developing scalable processes, playbooks, and quality frameworks that elevate team-wide execution
* Experience managing relationships with external law firms and immigration vendors, including setting quality expectations and enforcing SLAs
* Strong cross-functional partnership skills with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders (Legal, HR, Recruiting, Finance) without direct authority
* Experience leveraging AI or automation tools to drive efficiency in compliance monitoring and case processing workflows

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* J.D., immigration certification, or equivalent professional credential (e.g., AILA membership, CIPD, or country-specific immigration practitioner qualification)
* Experience operating within a global technology company or similarly complex, high-volume immigration environment
* Hands-on familiarity with immigration case management platforms and HR technology systems
* Experience supporting workforce restructuring, M&A integration, or new market entry from an immigration filings and compliance perspective
* Data-driven approach to measuring filing quality, cycle times, compliance health, and vendor effectiveness
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
