jobs.title: Clinical Program Manager
jobs.description:
First Place For Youth-Join Our Team Video!

**$5000 One-time Sign on Bonus!!!**  
  
Are you dedicated to empowering and supporting youth, regardless of their background? We're searching for passionate individuals to make a positive impact on the lives of foster youth. Become an integral part of their transformative journey and join the First Place for Youth team.

About First Place for Youth, we’re a leading non-profit organization dedicated to supporting foster youth in their transition to adulthood, with a focus on education, employment, and housing. We believe that all young people deserve the opportunity to thrive and lead successful, independent lives. Our comprehensive programs empower foster youth to overcome the unique challenges they face and build the skills, confidence, and connections they need to succeed.

**Why Work at First Place For Youth****:**

* **Meaningful Impact**: Help to transform the lives of foster youth on the cusp of adulthood. Your role will support them in their journey to conquer challenges, achieve independence, and fulfill their aspirations.
* **Innovative Approach:** We thrive on innovation, pushing the boundaries of foster care support. Your voice here matters, and you’ll contribute to programs that redefine the futures of these young lives.
* **Collaborative and Supportive Environment:** Embrace a dynamic and supportive workplace, where every team member is valued. Together, we're a force dedicated to uplifting youth. Expect professional growth, fueled by teamwork and collaboration.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** We value the well-being of our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package. From health and wellness benefits to retirement plans, we ensure that our team members are taken care of so they can focus on their important work supporting foster youth.
* **Culture of Diversity and Inclusion:** We celebrate diversity in every form. At First Place for Youth, inclusivity reigns, creating a workplace where all voices are heard, respected, and empowered.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Clinical Manager is an energetic, collaborative and results-oriented leader who will supervise Master’s level social work and multi-disciplinary case management staff and manage overall operations of an integrated services program. This position oversees our Transitional Living Program (TLP) which serves young adults referred through the SF homeless response system, our Youth Transitions Partnership (YTP) which leverages Dialectical Behavior Therapy, an evidence-based therapy that is supported for use in young people, and our My First Place (MFP) programming, a transitional housing program for young adults in the foster care/juvenile justice systems. The Clinical Manager provides leadership to a staff team of up to 6 professional and additional support staff ensuring effective, accurate program implementation, excellence in participant care, adherence to First Place for Youth policies, and efficient operations. The Manager is responsible to monitor outcomes toward achieving program and individual youth outcomes. The Manager participates on the middle management team and is responsible to coordinate with other agency departments, hire and evaluate staff teams, develop resources and implement training to ensure a well-trained high functioning team, and to provide direct oversight of all aspects of program to ensure quality and compliance. The Clinical Manager reports to the Director of Programs.

This position requires a clinical professional whose passion for First Place’s vision is matched with energetic leadership, sound judgment in the face of complex challenges, and a proven track record of successfully managing direct-service teams. This is currently a hybrid position requiring onsite work at a minimum of two-three days per week-and/or as needed depending on business need. jobs.title: Pooled Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

SF | Boston

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Department**
--------------

Customer Success

**Compensation**
----------------

* $130K – $150K

**About CodeRabbit**
--------------------

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

  

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

**Location: San Francisco, Boston or Austin**
---------------------------------------------

**About the team**
------------------

CodeRabbit is the AI code review platform. Development teams install it on their repositories and it reviews every pull request, so it sits in the daily workflow of a large and fast-growing customer base. The Scaled Success team is responsible for the health of that base, and works alongside a program manager, a content and enablement specialist and a success analytics engineer. The pooled customer success team is new within it, and this is one of its first roles.

**The role**
------------

You work a shared queue of customer accounts. Work arrives when a signal fires: onboarding has stalled, nothing has been configured, the only active user has gone quiet, a renewal is approaching, a cancellation has been started, or a team is using fewer seats than it has bought. You pick the case up, find out what is going on, get the customer configured and back to work, and close it out with a record the next person can read.

What you learn from the customers you work with feeds the playbooks, the automated campaigns and the triggers themselves. You work with the pooled team, the Content and Enablement Specialist, and the account executive who works expansion in the scaled lanes.

Few customer success teams run this way yet. You will learn how to move an account from default settings to a configured, renewing customer in a handful of conversations, and how to tell from the data which accounts need a person at all.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* The queue: pick up triggered accounts, respond within the team's standard, and resolve or route each one
* Configuration: take customers from default settings to a setup that fits their repositories, including Path Instructions, Learnings, pre-merge checks, IDE and CLI, and MCP
* Saves: work cancellation and non-renewal signals, understand the reason, fix what can be fixed, and record what cannot
* Renewals: run the renewal conversation where the signals say one is needed
* The expansion hand-off: when you see seat headroom or a buying signal, qualify it and pass it to the account executive with the context they need
* Playbook feedback: every case the playbook did not cover becomes a note, and patterns across those notes become new content, a new trigger, or new automation
* Case records: notes clean enough that anyone on the queue can pick up where you left off

**Your first quarter**
----------------------

* Complete product onboarding and work your first cases alongside the team
* Work the queue at the team's response standard
* Document the first ten cases where the playbook was missing or wrong, and propose the fix for each
* Contribute to the team's first readout: cases by trigger, resolution, and configuration movement on the accounts you touched

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 2+ years in customer success, technical support or solutions for a developer-facing product
* You have worked a ticket queue or a shared inbox at volume and kept quality up
* You write clearly in tickets, email and documentation
* You want to know why a customer left, and you record it every time
* You are comfortable on a team where the playbook is still being written

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You can read a YAML configuration file, open a pull request, run a CLI, and talk to an engineer about their workflow without a script
* You have used CodeRabbit or another AI code review tool
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and GitHub or GitLab workflows
* Experience with Pylon, Customer.io or a similar success or support platform
* Familiar with AI tooling and examples of you using it in similar roles

**How we work**
---------------

The team runs on measured results. Campaigns ship with control groups, numbers are labeled by source, and every report traces to rules anyone can audit.

Compensation Range: $130K - $150K

**The Center for Elders’ Independence (CEI)** provides a Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (P.A.C.E.) - a comprehensive healthcare model specifically designed for low-income, frail seniors. It combines medical and social services along with vigilant care planning and coordination in order to keep frail seniors safely living at home and in their communities. This unique and highly effective model utilizes an interdisciplinary team approach to care planning to drive high quality, affordable, integrated healthcare services to the elderly.

**Position****:** Under the supervision of Director of Enrollment and Member Services, the Benefits Case Manager ensures that all CEI participants are enrolled in all income and insurance benefits that they are eligible for. Benefits Case Manager will be required to work effectively with participants, participant families, representative payees and relevant government agencies to proactively maintain and address benefit eligibility issues that arise as well as support different prospect/participant benefit related projects within the agency.

The hourly pay range for the Benefits Case Manager position at Center for Elders’ Independence is $26.25 to $39.38. Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI’s annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Department and Caseload Management**

* Benefits Case Manager keeps track and ensures that all participants’ benefits eligibility needs are met; this includes working directly with the participants, participant families, representative payees and the relevant government agencies to proactively maintain benefit eligibility and resolve all eligibility issues that arise.
* Manages the assigned participant eligibility caseload which includes attending enrollment, care conference meetings and conducting home visits with participants where eligibility issues need to be addressed.
* Manages the caseload information on participants in a well-organized and secure filing system as devised by the department.
* Keeps track and monitors the eligibility status of the participant assigned to the caseload and generates regular reports as needed.

**Income Benefits**

* Ensures that the CEI participants’ income information assigned to the caseload is known and verified at all times and is well documented in the CEI database.

* Works with the participants, families and social workers connected to the assigned caseload to ensure that the Board and Care and SNF income level changes are made by the social security administration, that all involved understand the changes and that the benefit levels are accurate on all Board and Care documents.
* Communicates income issues to social work, finance, member services and other pertinent staff as needed affiliated with the participant on the caseload to ensure interdepartmental effectiveness.

**Insurance Benefits**

* Ensures that all CEI participants’ benefit information on the assigned caseload is known and verified at all times and well documented in the CEI database.
* Ensures that CEI participants who are assigned to the caseload are fully enrolled in Medi-Cal and any Medicare benefits they are eligible for prior to enrollment and following enrollment (ie assist with getting participants who are Medi-Cal only qualify for Medicare and participant missing Medicare Part A qualified for QMB benefit to obtain Part A coverage).
* Manages Medi-Cal re-certification to ensure that eligibility is maintained for all participants and facilitate proper communication and documents if retro payment request needs to be processed for month reflecting no payment code.
* Verify IHSS enrollment information prior to enrollment and document in CEI database for proper termination after enrollment.

* Strong case management skills. Ability to work closely with cross-functional team members including Outreach and Enrollment staff and IDT staff at the PACE centers.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both oral and written.
* Must be proficient with computer applications including spreadsheets, word processing and Customer Relationship Management (Salesforce).

* Possess the capacity to work in a high-stressed, high paced environment while maintaining a positive attitude.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.

* A passion for working with the senior and underserved populations.

jobs.title: Product Enablement Manager, AI Agents
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

This role sits within GTM Enablement, part of the broader Customer Solutions & Applied AI organisation responsible for turning Aircall's AI Voice Agent (AIVA) and AI Messaging Agent (AIMA) into adopted, well-understood products across the business. GTM Enablement works alongside Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Product Support, and Number Operations, globally across EMEA, AMER, and APAC. This is a new, dedicated enablement role created to keep the field current on AIVA and AIMA as they evolve, working in particularly close partnership with Forward Deployed Engineering and with the Product and Engineering teams shipping the roadmap.

As **Product Enablement Manager,** you will own how the field learns about every new AI Agent capability, use case, and release. This is a jack-of-all-trades, full-stack role: you need to be technical enough to understand agentic concepts such as intents, prompts, guardrails, and evals, creative enough to turn them into content people actually engage with, and comfortable producing that content yourself end to end, from writing through to filming and editing video. You'll work hand in hand with Forward Deployed Engineering to understand what the field actually needs, and directly with Product and Engineering to get ahead of what's shipping next. You are expected to be AI-first in how you work, using AI and agentic tooling to write, edit, and produce content at a scale a traditional enablement function could not, and to find agentic ways to enable the organisation more broadly, not only through content.

  

### **Core Responsibilities**

* Own internal and customer enablement for every new AIVA and AIMA launch, translating roadmap items and release notes into playbooks, one-pagers, and videos for Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Product Support, and GTM.
* Produce video as a default enablement format: script, record, and edit feature walkthroughs, demo videos, and "what changed and why it matters" explainers.
* Operate AI-first across the full content workflow, using AI tools to draft scripts, generate and edit video and audio, translate and localise content, and repurpose one asset into multiple formats.
* Build agentic tools and workflows that enable the organisation beyond content, such as internal agents that let teams self-serve answers or auto-generate first drafts of documentation.
* Work in lockstep with Forward Deployed Engineering to understand field pain points and priorities, and directly with Product and Engineering to get early visibility into what's shipping, so every release ships with an enablement plan ready to go.
* Build reusable frameworks, templates, and video formats that make each subsequent launch faster to enable than the last.
* Run live sessions, such as launch briefings or office hours, where they are the right tool, while defaulting to scalable, on-demand content wherever possible.
* Maintain a single, current source of truth for AIVA/AIMA product knowledge across the internal knowledge base or external customer LMS.
* Track enablement effectiveness, including content usage, time-to-competency on new features, and internal Q&A volume, and use that data to prioritise what to build next.
* Feed field questions, confusion points, and gaps back to Product and PMM so future releases ship with enablement already built in.

### **Qualifications:**

* 2–4+ years of experience in product enablement, technical writing, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, content/product marketing, or a similar hybrid role at a SaaS or AI/platform company. Candidates without a formal enablement title are welcome if the underlying skills below are there.
* Technical fluency: comfortable with agentic AI concepts (prompting, intents, guardrails, evaluation) and able to hold a credible technical conversation with Product and Engineering without a translator.
* Full-stack content skills: strong written communication, plus the hands-on ability to script, shoot, and edit video end to end, not just brief a production team.
* AI-native operator: you use AI tools fluently for writing, video and audio generation, editing, and content repurposing, and can build simple agentic tools or workflows rather than only using AI as an assistant.
* Proven ability to build something from scratch in a fast-moving environment with minimal structure, team, or budget.
* Strong stakeholder management across Product, Engineering,

jobs.title: Product Manager, Identity and Audience Onboarding
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

**Our Team**

The Ads Platform team builds the advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery across Netflix's world-class content ecosystem - balancing member experience with strong outcomes for advertisers. As one of the newest entrants in the fast-growing Connected TV advertising space, we're building the identity and audience infrastructure that differentiates Netflix from other ad-supported streaming services.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end lifecycle of the audience identifiers that power targeting, optimization, and measurement across Netflix Ads. You'll define and drive the roadmap for our identity management platform, spanning the identity graph, public APIs, direct advertiser integrations, partner ingestion, and unified identifier storage, and set the strategic direction for how Netflix builds a durable, privacy-forward identity foundation in a rapidly evolving ad tech landscape. Key Responsibilities include:

* Own product strategy and roadmap. Set the long-term vision for a unified identity platform that supports large-scale data ingestion, normalization, and retention, while balancing it against near-term delivery commitments.
* Lead product development. Partner with engineering, science and design to ship advertiser-facing products that make onboarding and managing advertising signals seamless.
* Drive cross-functional alignment. Work across sales, ad operations, marketing, strategy, policy, and legal to bring products to market and drive adoption at scale.
* Champion identity governance. Act as the subject matter expert on advertising identity governance and customer-facing data management.
* Communicate vision. Clearly articulate product strategy to stakeholders at every level, from engineering teams to executive leadership.

**We're Seeking a Candidate Who Has:**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience with a strong track record of launching and scaling ad tech platforms.
* Demonstrated success managing ad tech products through the full lifecycle, including delivery of advertiser-facing UIs.
* Deep understanding of the advertising ecosystem: CTV ads, identity/audience solutions, privacy enhancing technologies and data collaboration channels.
* Industry leading expertise in identity graph matching, including deterministic and probabilistic techniques for linking identifiers across devices and accounts
* Strong technical fluency designing integrations with ad servers, SSPs, and DSPs, with familiarity with APIs and integration frameworks.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functionally with Insights, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and other Product teams.
* Familiarity with legal compliance and the evolving global landscape of advertising regulation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, adapting quickly to shifting partner, strategy, and product priorities.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $440,000.00 - $725,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here .

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here .

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. to this job

Responsibilities

About Us Our Trust & Safety Safety Regulatory Compliance Operations team's commitment is to keep our online community safe. We have invested heavily in human and machine-based moderation to remove harmful content quickly and often before it reaches our general community. The Child Safety Team is responsible for reporting incidents of online sexual abuse of minors including child sexual abuse materials (CSAM), sexually predatory behavior including grooming, and other sexual exploitation involving minors to appropriate authorities, including the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC). The team is seeking an experienced people leader with excellent judgment, exceptional partnering skills and a passion for protecting children. Role Description As the Child Safety Team (CST) Lead, you’ll be guiding Child Safety Specialists to ensure the timely reporting of content across the broad spectrum of online child sexual exploitation and abuse. Through close partnerships with Legal, Policy, and Product, you will manage child sexual exploitation and abuse incidents to protect our online community. This role requires someone who will rapidly master internal workflows to anticipate systemic risks, ensuring the operation scales without compromising integrity. You will also work closely with internal teams to create and streamline cross-functional processes, and increase our overall efficiency to ensure our products are free of any violative content. This role will be regularly exposed to harmful child safety content as part of the core role. Additional harmful content you may be exposed to includes but is not limited to bullying; hate speech; sexual assault; torture; bestiality; self-harm; suicide; murder. jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager

Our cutting-edge company strives to become the most trusted, data-centric emergency services partner by uniting fragmented communications into actionable intelligence for first responders. At Intrado, all of our work truly matters.

Responsibilities:

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Business Operations Manager to help drive operational effectiveness, cross-functional execution, and strategic priorities across the organization. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can bring structure to ambiguity, and knows how to turn broad business needs into clear, actionable plans.

Working closely with Operations leadership and cross-functional partners, this individual will help organize priorities, drive initiatives forward, improve processes, track commitments, and ensure important work does not fall through the cracks.

This is an individual contributor role with significant visibility and influence across the organization. Success will require strong business judgment, organization, communication, and the ability to drive accountability without direct authority.

* Partner with Operations leadership to evaluate business challenges, identify opportunities, and translate strategic priorities into clear plans, actions, and measurable outcomes.

* Bring structure and organization to complex or ambiguous business challenges.

* Track priorities, commitments, risks, dependencies, and follow-up actions across multiple initiatives.

* Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement.

* Partner across functions to resolve roadblocks and maintain momentum on key initiatives.

* Analyze operational data and business trends to develop recommendations that support leadership decision-making.

* Prepare updates, recommendations, presentations, and other materials for senior leadership.

* Take ownership of high-priority or emerging initiatives that may not have a natural owner.

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

* 5 + years experience in business operations, project or program management, strategy and operations, process improvement, or a related field.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives simultaneously.

* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to create structure when requirements or solutions are not yet fully defined.

* Ability to influence, follow up, and drive accountability across teams without direct authority.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating with senior leaders.

* Experience identifying and improving business processes.

* Comfort working with data, metrics, reporting, and business performance indicators.

* Strong judgment with the ability to balance strategic priorities with tactical execution.

* Ability to adapt quickly as business needs and priorities change.

What Success Looks Like

* Leadership has greater visibility into priorities, risks, decisions, and progress.

* Important initiatives have clear ownership and consistently move forward.

* Cross-functional teams are better aligned and accountable.

* Operational processes become simpler, clearer, and more scalable.

* Complex or ambiguous problems are translated into organized, actionable plans.

**Who We Are****/**
-------------------

**Who We Are**

At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.

Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.

  

**Embracing Future-Facing Technology**

Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. This is a high-accountability client relationship role. You will be responsible for keeping client context, stakeholder needs, open questions, risks, follow-ups, and next steps clear across work that is often messy, fast-moving, and operationally complex.

The role exists because this kind of client work fails when account knowledge lives in scattered notes, private conversations, vague update loops, or one person's head. Your job is to turn that into a clear operating rhythm that clients trust and internal teams can actually use.

You will not personally build every system. You will be expected to understand the client problem, ask sharper questions, spot weak scope, maintain account context, prepare for the right conversations, and make sure Storm is solving the right thing in the right order.

AI is not an optional productivity trick in this role. You should be actively trying to become excellent at using AI tools, reusable workflows, and account-context systems to prepare better, move faster, remember more, and give clients a sharper experience.

This is also a relationship role in the real sense. Clients should like working with you. They should feel you understand them, enjoy the conversation, trust your follow-up, and want you involved when things are unclear.

If you are looking for a relationship-only account role where someone else owns the operational detail, this is not it. If you are looking for a pure project management or builder role with limited client responsibility, this is not it either.

**What You’ll Make Happen****/**
--------------------------------

**What can you expect?**

* Own the account context for selected Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design clients: stakeholders, priorities, history, open questions, risks, decisions, and follow-ups.
* Run the client operating rhythm so meetings, updates, actions, blockers, decisions, and handoffs do not drift or depend on memory.
* Turn vague client requests into clear next steps, questions, owners, dependencies, and decision points.
* Become highly capable with AI tools and workflows for account management: meeting preparation, account research, stakeholder mapping, summarisation, action tracking, client-ready drafting, QA, and reusable account memory.
* Use AI to make your client work sharper, not just faster. The standard is better context, better questions, better follow-up, and fewer things slipping through gaps.
* Make clients feel well looked after: clear communication, good energy, strong follow-up, useful questions, and the confidence that you are properly on top of their account.
* Write clear client-ready summaries that make messy work understandable without overpromising or hiding uncertainty.
* Maintain stakeholder maps, account notes, decision logs, follow-up trackers, and reusable context so Storm can manage the relationship professionally.
* Work closely with Account Management, Creative Operations, AI Operations, and technical colleagues to keep client work moving.
* Understand creative and operational workflows well enough to challenge weak assumptions, ask practical questions, and explain tradeoffs in plain English.
* Spot when a client ask is really a workflow, visibility, approval, stakeholder, or operating-rhythm problem.
* Help internal teams avoid overbuilding, underscoping, or saying yes before the client need is clear.
* Improve the way account knowledge is captured, summarised, shared, and reused over time.

**YOUR EXPERTISE****/**
-----------------------

* Demonstrable experience owning client relationships, stakeholder communication, account delivery, or complex operational conversations.
* Strong written and spoken English. You can make a messy situation feel clear, calm, and practical.

* Structured thinking. You can break ambiguous work into users, inputs, outputs, owners, statuses, risks, decisions, and definitions of done.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Bonneville Labs is a flexible coworking and traditional lab space operator and developer optimized for a community of Bio-Doers, emerging biotechnology companies, community partners, and life sciences market leaders. Bonneville Labs believes that research and development organizations can innovate faster when their mind-share is freed up from operations to focus on discovery and product development. Bonneville Labs seeks to improve our world and lives by eliminating operational hurdles and reducing the cost of research and development for our member companies and allowing them to go forward, faster toward world changing discoveries and businesses.

**Program Manager, Operations and Strategy**
============================================

Reports To: CEO

**Job Overview**
----------------

Bonneville Labs advances transformative bio‑economy solutions by removing operational friction for emerging biotechnology companies. Our coworking and traditional lab spaces support a community of Bio‑Doers who innovate faster when freed from operational burdens.

The Senior Program Manager leads strategic programs and drives hands‑on operational execution across multiple Bonneville Labs sites. This role builds structured systems, harmonizes workflows, and ensures programs move from planning to completion with clarity, accountability, and measurable outcomes. The Senior Program Manager works at both the high‑level planning layer and the day‑to‑day execution layer to support operational excellence, member experience, and continuous improvement.

This role is essential for aligning timelines, goals, documentation, and operational systems across the Bonneville Labs ecosystem. The Senior Program Manager supports our product mindset by treating each site, service, and workflow as a versioned product that requires continuous improvement, measurable outcomes, and predictable release cycles.

**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------

### **Program Leadership and Oversight**

* Lead assigned programs from ideation through planning, launch, and completion.
* Balance strategic planning with hands‑on execution to keep programs moving without gaps or delays.
* Ensure each project phase has clear ownership, verified completion, and documented quality checks.
* Conduct post‑implementation reviews and initiate timely improvements when needed.
* Oversee program dashboards, timelines, and tracking systems using Smartsheets, UpKeep, and related platforms.
* Identify execution gaps and intervene to ensure corrective actions are taken.
* Provide coaching, oversight, and accountability management for the Project Supervisor.
* Translate operational needs into structured backlogs, sprints, and release cycles.
* Maintain consistent standards, workflows, and performance expectations across all sites.

### **Cross‑Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate work across Lab Operations, Lab Safety and Compliance, Facilities, Member Services, Community, Scientific Services, and Business Operations.
* Facilitate communication and reporting to ensure clarity of expectations, deliverables, and timelines.
* Lead cross‑functional project meetings, document decisions, and track action items.
* Support multi‑site initiatives and harmonization of processes across all Bonneville Labs locations.
* Serve as a central point of contact for program updates, escalations, and issue resolution.
* Partner with leadership to ensure programs support member experience, operational uptime, and regulatory compliance.
* Support KPI tracking across programs including uptime, NPS, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency.

### **Documentation and Quality Management**

* Develop, update, and implement SOPs, protocols, and operational documentation.
* Maintain document control procedures including version control, access permissions, and archival.
* Ensure documentation meets regulatory, safety, and quality standards in coordination with the Senior Manager of EHS.
* Convert tribal knowledge into structured, repeatable documentation that supports future site expansion.
* Support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System.
* Assist in development and implementation of Environmental Health and Safety Management Plans and operational guidelines.

### **Continuous Improvement and Product Mindset**

* Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements to workflows, systems, and processes.
* Implement tools and methodologies that enhance tracking, documentation, and reporting.
* Lead harmonization and continuous improvement projects across teams and sites.
* Support development of operational frameworks, testing services, and scalable systems for future sites.
* Recommend improvements that support member experience and operational excellence.
* Support automation initiatives such as ticket routing, asset tracking, and predictive maintenance pilots.
* Contribute to monthly or quarterly operational release notes.
* Coordinate predictable release cycles and communicate improvements across teams and to members.

### **Operations and Site Support**

* Support day‑to‑day operations across multiple Bonneville Labs sites.
* Assist with project planning and ownership of assigned operational systems.
* Provide onsite or virtual support for Bay Area sites as determined by leadership.
* Prepare detailed presentations summarizing program status, risks, and outcomes.
* Support emergency response coordination and communication with external stakeholders when needed.
* Ensure suppliers, contractors, and member companies comply with Bonneville Labs policies and safety guidelines.
* Support operational readiness for new site launches through documentation, playbooks, and process standardization.
* Monitor vendor and contractor performance to ensure service levels support operational uptime and member experience.

### **Stakeholder and Member Support**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, external partners, and member companies.

jobs.description:
**Project Manager III (Remote) - (NASA eMITS)**

Rothe is seeking a Project Manager to provide remote project management for the Information Management Division (IMD) in the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) in support of the NASA Enterprise Multimedia and Integrated Technical Services (eMITS) contract. eMITS is the Agency’s enterprise-level contract creating and delivering multimedia and technical communications through the use of the internet, digital platforms, and IT management for NASA’s Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) and Office of Communications (OCOMM). From photographing rocket launches and recoveries, to producing engaging videos, to information technology management, to using social media to share NASA’s message, eMITS integrates services for NASA IT and provides NASA’s communication to the outside world. Come join us in support of NASA’s mission to inspire the world through information and discovery.

**Job Description:**

The Project Manager position will include but not be limited to the following efforts:

Provide IT Service Management (ITSM) project management support focused on the transition/migration from legacy tools to enterprise solutions and the decommissioning of legacy tools once enterprise solutions are operational. Services include project management, lifecycle governance, process re-engineering, data migration oversight, system integration coordination, organizational change management, stakeholder engagement, and training coordination, and vendor and financial governance to include, but is not limited to;

**Functional Responsibilities:**

* Provide the following services in support of Migration and Decommissioning Project Management & Lifecycle Governance
  + Lead the end-to-end lifecycle for the migration and decommissioning of legacy platforms/tools to the new enterprise platform (e.g., ServiceNow).
  + Develop, maintain, and actively track migration and decommissioning schedules, timelines, and milestones to ensure on-time delivery.
* Provide the following services in support of Process Redesign & Workflow Alignment.
  + Map existing workflows (e.g. including Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration Management) to the capabilities of the new platform.
  + Facilitate the optimization and re-engineering of core processes to ensure alignment with platform best practices and organizational requirements.
* Provide the following services in support of Data Migration, Records Retention and Integrations.
  + Oversee the transfer of historical data, Configuration Items (CIs), knowledge articles, user directories, etc. to the new enterprise solutions(s).
  + Oversee required API integration efforts.
* Provide the following services in support of Stakeholder, Change & Quality Management.
  + Coordinate cross-functional teams and champion ongoing buy-in throughout the project lifecycle.
  + Coordinate/Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate system functionality against business requirements prior to launch.
  + Manage organizational change communication, drive user adoption strategies, and coordinate the delivery of training programs for internal support teams.
  + Develop and execute a decommissioning communication plan, providing clear, advanced notification of the final cutoff date and operational impacts to all stakeholders, end-users, and internal support teams.
* Provide Discovery and Dependency Mapping to compile a comprehensive audit to inventory and map all dependencies tied to the legacy tools, including internal and external integrations.
* Manage the clearance of all active queues, ensuring that all open tickets, change requests, and active service catalog items are appropriately resolved, closed, or migrated to the new platform prior to system shutdown.

**Education and Experience:**

Minimum Education: BA/BS in Project Management, Communications, Business Administration, or an IT related discipline

Minimum Experience: 8 years

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8 years of project management experience
* 3-5 years of business/mission (outcomes/impacts), strategic/tactical (project planning) and operational (implementation/service/product delivery)
* Project Management Certification:
  + Project Management Professional (PMP) certification and/or
  + Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) and/or
  + Certified Scrum Master (CSM) and/or
  + Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
* Experience with Risk Management and best practices
* Experience using tools for requirements gathering and implementation
* Experience in creating and maintaining Integrated master schedules and applying earned value management techniques (desired, not required)
* Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneNote, OneDrive), and SharePoint.

**Preferred Qualifications (not required for consideration):**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* ITIL Certification
* Exceptional stakeholder management and the ability to bridge the gap between technical teams and government customers
* Ability to work in complex, ambiguous, and fast-paced environments
* Strategy Management
* Microsoft SharePoint
* Microsoft Project

For this remote position, the employee bears travel costs to the nearest NASA Center for badging and issue of NASA IT equipment, and must have a reliable internet connection and be able to VPN into the NASA network to conduct work.

Rothe is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Parasol Alliance is a technology solutions company exclusively serving the senior living industry. We provide leadership and comprehensive in-house technology support, helping our clients make smart strategic technology investments and effectively use technology to achieve their business objectives.

Our strategic focus forms the core of Parasol Partnerships. These partnerships lead to increased efficiency, productivity, and profitability for our clients. We make our clients more successful – and we have the data to prove it.

***Leadership defines us. We are innovative leaders in everything we do.***

**Position Mission**

The Project Manager is responsible and accountable for the coordination and completion of projects on time, within budget and within scope. The Project Manager will ensure full and accurate visibility of project statuses is provided to client and vendor stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for effectively prioritizing and managing project resources across multiple projects regarding project priority and established project schedules.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the execution of projects.
* Ensure that projects are delivered on time, within scope and within budget.
* Translate technical plans into operational impacts and value to the clients
* Assist in the definition of project scope and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility.
* Assist in the development of project plans and ‘big picture’ planning
* Ensure resource availability and allocation.
* Develop comprehensive project plans to be shared with clients as well as other staff members.
* Manage changes to the project scope, project schedule and project costs using appropriate verification techniques.
* Perform risk management to minimize project risks.
* Establish and maintain relationships with third parties/vendors.
* Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation.
* Assign project tasks based on assigned project resources strengths, skill sets and experience levels.

**Requirements**

* PM experience; 1+ years of experience.
* Experience managing projects involving Microsoft technologies (e.g., M365, Azure AD, Intune) and confidently guiding clients through related projects is a plus.
* Healthcare experience preferred; long-term healthcare experience is a plus.
* Proven working experience in project management.
* Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus.

**The Right Fit**

This job requires strong analytical and technical abilities and demands fast, but carefully thought-out results. Strong leadership and control of the work process from beginning to end is necessary. The job centers around developing new ideas, systems, and technology, and analyzing and improving on old ones. A high level of expertise is expected and the ability to spot and correct errors is important. Work must be done right and quickly, while always focusing on accomplishing the goal and demanding the highest quality work from co-workers and subordinates. Interest and energy focus primarily on the work at hand, with negligible inclination for small talk or social involvement. The broad scope of the job demands a factual, direct, and authoritative style of communication. Decision-making, though swift, is very calculated and singular, with little reliance on consensus or collaborating opinions.

**Benefits**

* Cell phone/internet reimbursement
* Medical, dental, vision, 401k
* Flexible paid time off
* Certification reimbursement

**Company Culture**

We are an IT company but believe technology support should be directly related to your business success. Technology for technology’s sake is not what we are about. We intertwine the knowledge economy with technology to transform and interconnect our expertise with your company to expand the decision-making capabilities and ensure productivity and cost effectiveness.

Our Values:

* Expertise
* Collaboration
* Empathy
* Integrity

If you want to work for a value-driven, high-performance company and to experience an exciting opportunity to help grow a company then this is the job for you. We are looking for our team members to take ownership and pride in their work, and to provide input and guidance for the clients of Parasol. We are a virtual company that offers work from home, responsible time off and bonus opportunities.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
70,000 - 75,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

**Job description**  
The Project Manager: This position acts as the single point of contact for customers during project execution and is responsible for the successful completion of projects for the organization. The role will be to control project scopes, create and maintain project timelines, track labor needs, material needs, construction schedules, and work closely with several functional teams to ensure projects are completed with good quality and on schedule.  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Clarify requirements, track project performance, ensure full scope delivery on time and within budget.
* Develop comprehensive and/or high-level project plans to be shared with internal teams, vendors, and customers.
* Coordinate and supervise dispersed project team.
* Monitor project issues, scope changes, risks and milestones providing confident and honest project progress evaluation to internal teams and customers.
* Remove project roadblocks and creatively assist in conflict resolution to improve team productivity and overall project delivery.
* Report on project and portfolio progress on a weekly or as needed basis.
* Assist in verifying projects are being completed to drawings/specifications/SOPs.
* Keep project documentation organized and up to date, manage documentation version control.
* Use and continually develop leadership skills serving as a role model throughout each project.
* Maintain a safe work environment.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Familiarity with Project Management software and time management tools.
* Experience with process improvement and inventory control.
* Experience working with cross-functional dispersed teams.
* Knowledge of or interest in the construction industry.
* Ability to manage and effectively prioritize numerous projects at one time.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
* Excellent leadership and organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office products.
* Advanced time management and analytical skills.
* Demonstrate a strong sense of initiative and urgency.
* Ensure project deadlines are met in a fast-paced environment.
* Team player. Ability to work well with all levels in the organization.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Familiar with a similar product/platform: Brivo, Open Eye, Eagle Eye, Residio, Honeywell, Control 4, Creston, Real Page, Livly, Stratis, Schlage, etc.

**Technical Knowledge:**

* Basic understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, switches, routers, wireless access points).
* Familiarity with Wi-Fi deployment projects, site surveys, AP placement, MDF/IDF rooms, and structured cabling.
* Ability to read construction drawings, floor plans, and low-voltage designs.
* Understanding of conduit pathways, cable routing, and telecommunications infrastructure.

**Education and Experience:**

* High School Diploma or GED required. College preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in construction, low-voltage, telecommunications, or technology deployments.
* Experience coordinating or supporting Wi-Fi, network, fiber, access control, surveillance, or structured cabling installations.
* Familiarity with commercial, multifamily, hospitality, or campus construction environments.
* Experience working with contractors, electricians, and property/site teams.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Up to 5% travel to out of state job sites and/or office locations.
* Ability to lift 25 lbs.
* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

jobs.description:

As a **project manager lead** in the Corporate Human Resources (HR) Project Management Office (PMO), you'll lead the end-to-end delivery of large, complex corporate HR projects and programs. In this role, you'll work with project sponsors and various stakeholders, including business and technical resources. Projects are enterprise-level and may vary widely from system implementations to HR initiatives to large-scale programs. You'll perform all aspects of project management, including developing project scope and objectives, stakeholder analysis, project planning, project team communication, and organizational change management. This is a remote position with occasional travel to Corporate Headquarters (300 North Commons Blvd., Mayfield Village, Ohio) roughly one to two times per year.

* High school diploma/GED equivalent or higher and a minimum nine years of related work experience leading projects and project delivery.

jobs.title: Scaffolding Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and execution of temporary tent structures, scaffolding systems, and related event infrastructure. This role oversees projects from initial planning and site assessment through installation, event operations, dismantling, and post-project review.

The Project Manager works closely with clients, sales teams, operations, engineers, vendors, crew leads, and field staff to ensure that temporary structures are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and in accordance with project requirements, site conditions, manufacturer specifications, and applicable safety standards. This a National role and does not need to be located in one of our offices. Travel will be required.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage tent structure, scaffolding, and temporary infrastructure projects from planning through completion.
* Review project requirements, site plans, drawings, layouts, specifications, and installation schedules.
* Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Clients, vendors, engineers, and field crews to establish project scope, requirements, and expectations.
* Conduct or coordinate site assessments to identify access limitations, ground conditions, utilities, overhead obstructions, staging areas, and other potential installation challenges.
* Develop project timelines, installation schedules, dismantling plans, equipment requirements, and crew requirements.
* Coordinate tent structure and scaffolding equipment, components, hardware, ballast, rigging, flooring, lighting, and other required materials.
* Work with asset and logistics teams to develop accurate load lists and coordinate transportation to and from job sites.
* Coordinate delivery, staging, installation, inspection, modification, and dismantling of temporary structures.
* Work closely with crew leads to ensure structures are installed efficiently and according to approved plans and procedures.
* Monitor project progress and make adjustments to labor, equipment, schedules, and logistics as required.
* Job Costing – coordinating with Sales & Operations and Management to review project estimates, change orders and additional labor or equipment impacting job cost.
* Identify potential structural, safety, logistical, or operational issues before and during installation and implement appropriate solutions.
* Coordinate with engineering or qualified technical personnel when site conditions or project requirements require structural review or engineering input.
* Ensure work is performed in accordance with applicable safety requirements, manufacturer specifications, approved plans, and company procedures.
* Maintain a strong focus on fall protection, site safety, lifting operations, equipment handling, and safe work practices.
* Conduct or coordinate pre-installation and post-installation inspections as required.
* Verify that completed structures meet project requirements and maintain a professional, high-quality presentation.
* Coordinate setup and takedown activities to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and within established timelines.
* Communicate project changes, scope changes, site conditions, additional labor, equipment requirements, and potential cost impacts to Sales and management promptly.
* Provide End-of-Day Reports, project updates, and post-event After Action Reports.
* Identify opportunities for additional services, equipment, structures, or enhancements that may benefit the client.
* Provide constructive feedback and practical solutions for challenges encountered in the field.
* Maintain positive working relationships with clients, crews, subcontractors, vendors, venues, and internal departments.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining accurate documentation and communication.
* Create a professional and positive team environment both in the office and at job sites.
* Travel to local, in-state, and out-of-state job sites as required.
* Work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on project schedules.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Requirements:**

* Experience with large-scale temporary tent structures.
* Experience with scaffolding installation or project coordination.
* Construction or event-production background.
* Familiarity with temporary structure engineering, anchoring, ballast, and load requirements.
* OSHA or equivalent safety training.
* Familiarity with site plans, CAD drawings, structural drawings, or technical documentation.
* Experience managing union or non-union field crews.
* Experience coordinating cranes, forklifts, lifts, trucking, and other heavy equipment.
* Experience working with engineers, structural consultants, or permitting authorities.

**Disclaimer:**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

jobs.description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we're building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you're ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There's no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it's from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

This role sits at the intersection of design craft, technical operations, and strategic execution. You'll bring strong design sensibility—whether from product design or design systems—to build scalable programs, automate workflows using AI, and ensure our design team has the infrastructure, tools, and processes to deliver world-class experiences efficiently. ==================

You'll leverage AI to automate workflows, manage critical vendor relationships (Figma, design tooling, contractors), and create repeatable systems that translate our design, creative and product strategy into shipped experiences.

You'll report to the Director of Technical Program Management and work closely with Design and Product Leadership, Marketing, Engineering, and several other cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes that matter.

**About the Job**
=================

* **Programmatic Execution:** Drive end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-quarter design initiatives across Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Business Development and other cross-functional teams. Enable seamless cross-functional collaboration and predictable program outcomes.

Drive governance programs that scale IDS across product teams. Act as strategic partner to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Operations. * **Design Craft Integration:** Apply design thinking and product sense to program design—understanding user needs, designing operational experiences, and iterating based on feedback. Build systems that empower designers and product managers to do their best work while balancing flexibility with consistency, creative exploration with scalable patterns, and craft excellence with business impact.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Marketing PMO
jobs.description:
**Senior Project Manager, Marketing PMO**

As a Senior Project Manager on Intapp’s Marketing PMO team, you will lead complex, high-priority, cross-functional marketing initiatives from planning through completion while helping mature how the Marketing organization plans and delivers work. You will bring structure to ambiguity, facilitate collaboration across teams, drive accountability, and ensure projects deliver against their intended outcomes. This role is ideal for an experienced project leader who combines strong PM fundamentals with the judgment, initiative, and communication skills to independently drive complex work and know when to escalate.

**What you will do**

* **Lead complex projects end-to-end:** Own high-visibility, cross-functional marketing initiatives, translating business objectives into clear scope, plans, milestones, deliverables, owners, dependencies, and timelines. Manage scope and changes throughout the project lifecycle and apply the appropriate level of project management rigor based on the complexity and needs of the initiative.
* **Drive execution, governance, and accountability:** Establish and maintain appropriate project governance, facilitate working sessions and project meetings, identify next steps, manage risks and issues, resolve blockers, and keep teams moving toward outcomes. Independently address issues where appropriate and escalate material risks or decisions to the Director, Marketing PMO with clear context, options, and recommendations.
* **Partner across the organization:** Collaborate with Marketing, Creative, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Events, Communications, Operations, and other stakeholders to align priorities and drive accountability without direct authority. Work closely with other PMs to create consistency and share effective practices across the team.
* **Strengthen PMO processes and methodology:** Help develop and mature project management methodology, governance, templates, documentation, and standards. Identify gaps and inefficiencies, implement practical improvements, and use lessons learned to continuously improve how projects are planned and delivered.
* **Create visibility and institutional knowledge:** Manage projects in Asana and other PM tools, maintain accurate project plans, risks, issues, decisions, actions, and status, and provide clear, actionable reporting. Ensure project outcomes, decisions, and lessons learned are captured to build institutional knowledge and support a consistent, scalable PMO.

**What you will need**

Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team. To apply for this Senior Project Manager role, you will ideally have:

* Strong project management fundamentals and demonstrated experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects from initiation through completion.

The Senior Refuel Floor Specialist (Project Manager) will provide direct management and supervision of Boiling Water Reactor (BWR) Refuel Floor maintenance activities, including Reactor Disassembly, Reassembly, and In Vessel Maintenance. This individual will support the safe execution of complex projects and activities involving BWR 2-6 Refuel Floor outages. The Project Manager will be responsible for all aspects of the project from ITO through OTR and serve as the primary GVH representative for Refuel Floor scope delivery.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Serve as the single point of contact and maintain ownership of all Refuel Floor related tasks for GVH owned outage scope.
* Manage all aspects of the Refuel Floor project from ITO through OTR, including technical communications, risk assessment, financial monitoring and forecasting.
* Provide project delivery planning leadership and rigor. Transition planning, risk identification, risk mitigation, and contingency planning.
* Responsible for leading and coaching multi-disciplined and multi-cultural teams composed of GVH and contingent worker personnel, including craft labor.
* Provide direct supervision of union and non-union personnel performing activities related to BWR Refuel Floor outage maintenance work.

* Exemplify our GE Beliefs and demonstrate integrity, nuclear safety, and quality culture.

* Drive standard GVH processes across projects and ensure procedural compliance.

jobs.title: Senior Transformation Program Lead, Billing Modernization
jobs.description:
**Description**

The Senior Transformation Program Lead will lead the North America Billing transformation; a critical multi-year initiative focused on modernizing billing capabilities through the implementation of the Majesco platform.

This role serves as the Overall Program Lead (OPL), bringing together business, technology, operations, and delivery partners around a unified transformation roadmap and ensuring the program is positioned to deliver its intended business outcomes. The OPL will provide end-to-end leadership across the transformation, creating clarity across a complex portfolio of work, connecting interdependencies, enabling timely decisions, and ensuring leaders and teams remain aligned on priorities, outcomes, risks, and execution.

Success in this role requires a leader who can operate equally effectively at the executive and delivery levels. The OPL will partner closely with senior business and technology leaders, product and engineering teams, functional experts, and external partners to translate strategy into an executable roadmap and drive disciplined execution across a large, complex transformation.

Ultimately, the Senior Transformation Program Lead is accountable for connecting strategy to execution and creating a culture of execution excellence across the transformation. This leader will establish the operating discipline, accountability, transparency, and ways of working that enable a complex, multi-year program to perform at its best. They will set the tone for how teams work together, how decisions are made, how challenges are surfaced and resolved, and how the organization continuously learns and adapts to deliver meaningful and sustainable business value.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Lead the transformation end to end.** Provide overall program leadership for the multi-year North America Billing transformation, aligning business, technology, operations, and delivery teams around a common vision, roadmap, and set of outcomes.
* **Turn strategy into executable plans.** Translate transformation objectives into an integrated program roadmap with clear outcomes, milestones, dependencies, decision points, and measures of success.
* **Establish strong program governance.** Partner with executive sponsors and program leadership to establish effective governance, decision rights, escalation paths, and operating rhythms that enable timely decisions and clear accountability.
* **Drive integrated execution.** Establish a rigorous and connected execution model across the transformation, maintaining a holistic view across business and technology workstreams. Proactively identify dependencies, sequencing considerations, resource needs, risks, and barriers, and drive issues through resolution to protect outcomes and momentum.
* **Connect business and technology.** Ensure business capabilities, operating-model changes, process requirements, technology decisions, and implementation plans remain connected and aligned throughout the transformation.
* **Lead through complexity.** Surface critical decisions and tradeoffs, frame options for senior leaders, and help the program move forward when priorities, dependencies, or perspectives compete.
* **Own program health and transparency.** Create clear visibility into progress, outcomes, financials, risks, dependencies, and decisions, ensuring leaders have the information needed to actively govern the transformation.
* **Partner across organizational boundaries.** Build strong relationships across GRS and with internal and external partners, creating shared accountability for outcomes rather than operating through individual functions or workstreams.
* **Build a culture of execution excellence.** Establish the operating discipline, behaviors, and ways of working required for a high-performing transformation. Create clear accountability for outcomes, reinforce transparency and constructive challenge, and ensure teams consistently follow through on decisions and commitments while continuously improving how the program executes.
* **Maintain focus on value and outcomes.** Continuously connect program execution to the business outcomes the transformation is intended to achieve, challenging the organization to adapt plans as new information emerges.

**How You’ll Show Up**

* **Create a culture of execution excellence**. Set a high bar for how the program operates and delivers. Foster a culture where accountability is clear, commitments matter, risks and issues are surfaced early, constructive challenge is welcomed, and teams work together to solve problems and deliver outcomes.

jobs.title: Patient Engagement Specialist (CareSync Coordinator)
jobs.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.

**Department:** Patient Support Center – CareSync

**Position Type:** Full-Time | Remote | Hourly, Non-Exempt

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7 AM–6:00 PM CT; flexibility to support new patient inbound coverage as needed.

**Who We Are**

Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our mission is to empower our patients to live healthier, more rewarding lives through accessible, affordable, and effective mental healthcare tailored to their needs. Our Patient Support Center is the front door to that care, often a patient’s first human connection with Geode and the first step in removing barriers between someone seeking help and the provider who can support them.

**The Role**

The **Patient Engagement Specialist** is a high-impact, outbound-first role at the heart of patient access and acquisition. You are the voice that reaches out to patients after they’ve been referred or expressed interest in care, helping them move from referral to a scheduled first visit. You’ll process incoming referrals, make timely and persistent outreach, and deliver white-glove support to the referring providers who trust us with their patients. You’ll also flex to answer new patient inbound calls when volume calls for it.

This is a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment for people who care deeply about both outcomes and experience. You’ll use strong virtual human connection, sound judgment, and follow-through to remove barriers to care, connect each patient to the right provider, and keep referring partners informed every step of the way. If you bring empathy, urgency, and a growth mindset, and believe every outreach is an opportunity to help someone take the next step, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**

**Drive Outbound Engagement & Conversion**

* Proactively call referred patients and new patient leads, making first contact the same or next business day and following a structured outreach cadence until the patient is scheduled or the referral is closed.
* Convert referrals and leads into scheduled first visits by matching each patient to the right provider using screening questions, insurance, provider preferences, and scheduling tools.
* Guide hesitant patients toward a confident “yes” using empathy, reflective listening, communication frameworks, and sound judgment while removing barriers without pressure.
* Set clear expectations for the first visit so patients arrive informed, comfortable, and ready to attend.
* Meet individual and team targets for speed to first outreach, contact rate, and referral-to-scheduled conversion.

**Process Referrals Accurately**

* Receive, review, and process incoming referrals from email, fax, phone, and partner channels promptly and accurately.
* Confirm patient demographic and insurance information is complete and accurate; follow up with the referring office or patient to close any gaps.
* Track each referral from receipt to first visit so status is clear to referring partners and internal teams.
* Build and maintain working knowledge of accepted insurance plans.

**Deliver White-Glove Support to Referring Providers**

* Serve as a responsive, reliable point of contact for referring provider offices, answering questions and sharing timely referral status updates.
* Close the loop with referring providers by confirming receipt, sharing scheduling outcomes, and letting them know when another level of care may be a better fit.
* Build trusted relationships with key partner practices so Geode is an easy, dependable place to send their patients.

**Flex to Support New Patient Inbound Calls**

* Answer new patient inbound calls during peak volume or as assigned, with warmth, urgency, and a bias toward booking the first visit.
* Partner with the Patient Support Center team to keep handoffs seamless for patients and providers.

**Grow Through Coaching & Quality**

* Work toward individual and team goals for conversion, outreach timeliness, contact rate, quality, and documentation, using feedback and performance insights to keep improving.
* Welcome regular call auditing and coaching as fuel for growth; apply feedback quickly and consistently.
* Document every outreach attempt and interaction accurately in our systems with the right context and a clear next step.

**Own the Patient & Provider Experience**

* Create a calm, personalized experience that helps patients feel confident taking the next step in care.
* Protect patient privacy by maintaining strict confidentiality and following HIPAA and all privacy requirements.
* Flex with changing workflows, volumes, and schedules while supporting the broader team as needs shift.

**Who You Are**

* A hospitality-minded people person - you make others feel genuinely cared for and you love creating great experiences.
* Energized by outbound outreach - comfortable making proactive calls and following up with persistence and care.
* Motivated by goals and comfortable using feedback and performance insights to improve.
* A persuasive, empathetic communicator who can navigate emotional or complex conversations with calm and confidence.
* Organized and process-oriented - you track details closely and keep every referral moving.
* Coachable and self-aware - you welcome feedback, know your strengths, and actively develop your areas of opportunity.
* Passionate about mental healthcare and Geode’s mission to expand access to exceptional care.

**What You Bring**

* 1–3+ years in a customer-facing, phone-based, or hospitality role; experience in a medical office, mental health, referral coordination, outbound calling, or sales/conversion is a strong plus.
* Comfort working in a goal-oriented, quality-focused environment.
* Familiarity with insurance plans and benefits, or the ability to learn them quickl
